review_candidates.title: Health, Safety & Environment Manager
review_candidates.description: Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride. You will manage the delivery of all HSE activities in a manufacturing facility or commercial areas (offices, Sales, Warehouses) , including standards & procedures, capability processes, reporting, compliance and audit. That means you will define and review standards and legislation applicable to site, validate design for HSE into projects and modifications, and support defined work processes (e.g. IIM pillar) to improve HSE application and effectiveness. Also, you will map all applicable legislation and internal standards, ensure ongoing compliance and manage relationship with legal department and local authorities. You will maintain all HSE regulatory requirements for plant How You Will Contribute You will: Co-ordinate implementation of all HSE programs and processes. Prepare and build consensus annual plans for facility/function wide HSE initiatives Plan/Budget/Control annual capital budget for HSE to enable execution of the HSE plan and adherence to all internal and external compliance standards Provide HSE expertise for the facility/function for all new projects and change management activities Ensure appropriate risk assessments are conducted and follow ups implemented to minimize or eliminate accidents, asset losses that might cause harm to one of the company’s employees, contractors, visitors Ensure that the appropriate talent is in place through training, mentoring, and succession planning and supports development and learning capabilities of Safety specialists Ensure the facility standards are in compliance with both Company and governmental/community regulations Ensure training and coaching are taking place to drive a safety-perfect culture and to ensure safety standards and awareness are well understood throughout the plant organization What You Will Bring A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in: Experience as a Health, Safety and Environment Practitioner preferably within a manufacturing or commercial environment Demonstrated experience managing a team, change management and project management Excellent interpersonal communication and influencing skills with internal and external stakeholders at all levels Experience with Health and Safety audit experience More About This Maintains the development of systems and processes to achieve and exceed compliance with all HSE requirements and HSE company policies. Provides HSE expertise and recommendations to HSE functions. Conducts and oversees investigations and ensures the quality and outcomes of investigations continuously improves at each facility. Monitors the HSE performance of MDLZ international. Develops and communicates reports to measure HSE performance against agreed improvement targets. Drives improvements of HSE performance through Mondelez International HSE standards Maintains and/or develops best practices for Health, Safety and Environmental management / Performance and roll out across the region Supports the implementation and development of HSE management software(s) that includes, event reporting & investigation, HSE metric tracking, audit management, risk assessment, document management, and training. Develops or acquires custom tools or procedures to ensures sites and regions are in compliance with Company HSE standards What extra ingredients you will bring: HSE Management IT systems including (Systems and software development and Management) HSE Management Systems- Standards, external certifications & compliance Management. Accident and incident Investigation Management Root Cause Analysis and Corrective action management Risk Assessment Hazard Recognition and Control Education / Certifications: Degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Environment or Health & Safety. Job specific requirements: Qualification in HS&E management systems - Enablon Training and qualification in auditing Knowledge of Risk Assessment and Risk management techniques to identify improvement opportunities Minimum 10 years of relevant experience No Relocation support available Business Unit Summary Mondelēz International in the Middle East, North Africa and Pakistan serves the Middle East and Africa markets as well as Australia, New Zealand, the UK and Canada. Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, we have more than 2600 employees working across seven plants and six commercial offices; we make, bake, sell and deliver our products to customers. We are market leaders in key snacking categories with iconic global and local brands including Cadbury Dairy Milk chocolate, Milka, Oreo and belVita biscuits, Barni Cakes,Tang powdered beverage, Chiclets and Trident gum and Halls candy. Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Job Type Regular Health, Safety & Environment Manufacturing

review_candidates.title: Global Product Support Specialist – Rotary Drilling
review_candidates.description: Sandvik's Rotary Drilling Division in Alachua, FL — part of a global engineering leader with 41,000 employees worldwide and a place on Forbes' Top 100 Global Employers list — designs and builds some of the world's most advanced surface mining drilling rigs, used on every inhabited continent. We're looking for a hands-on Global Product Support Specialist – Rotary Drilling to be the technical go-to for our global sales areas — diagnosing complex mechanical, hydraulic, and control-system issues, commissioning new machines at mine sites around the world, and training our frontline teams and customers on the equipment they operate every day. If you thrive on solving tough problems in the field and want your work to move the mining industry forward — keep reading. What You Will Do As a Global Product Support Specialist, you will take technical ownership of Sandvik Rotary Drilling products in the field, supporting our frontline sales and service teams around the world. Your day-to-day will include: Providing timely technical support on Sandvik Rotary Drilling products to customer sites domestically and internationally. Troubleshooting mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical/control-system issues on rotary blasthole drills, including onboard control-system calibration, software installations, and firmware updates. Leading on-site commissioning and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) of new drill rigs and supporting New Product Introductions to sales areas. Configuring drill control-system software and machine parameters using Sandvik's frontline service tools. Delivering hands-on classroom and mine-site training to Sandvik frontline teams, Sales Area Product Masters, technicians, and customers. Investigating and resolving field issues through root cause failure analysis, in close collaboration with Product Engineering. Reviewing Continuous Product Improvement (CPI) cases with Technical Support, Engineering, Sales, Product Management, and Manufacturing. Advising on recommended spare parts lists and warranty recommendations, and maintaining Technical Support documentation. About You Work Authorization Ability to work in the U.S. on a full-time indefinite basis without current or future employer sponsorship. Temporary work authorizations such as F-1 OPT/STEM OPT are not sufficient for this position. Experience & Education Minimum of 10 years in a technical role supporting heavy mobile equipment, including at least 5 years working directly with drilling or comparable surface mining equipment. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Mining Engineering — or an equivalent trade/technical qualification combined with extensive, demonstrated field experience on drilling or heavy mobile equipment. (Degrees in IT, computer science, or software engineering alone are not a fit for this role.) Proven track record delivering hands-on technical training. Skills, Travel & Certifications Strong hydraulic, mechanical, and electrical troubleshooting skills, with the ability to read hydraulic and electrical schematics. Working knowledge of PLC-based control systems and machine diagnostic tools. Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities independently at remote sites. Excellent communication, organization, and time-management skills; solid Microsoft Office and technical/service software skills. Willingness to travel internationally and domestically (:30–40%), including to remote mine sites. Valid U.S. passport (or ability to obtain) and valid driver's license required. MSHA (Part 46/48) and First Aid certifications preferred. What We Offer Health care (medical, dental, vision, prescription, telemedicine) starting 30 days after hire. Paid vacation with up to 80 hours rollover. Paid parental leave (eligibility after 12 months of service). 401(k) with 5% annual salary contribution + 50% match on the first 6%. Tuition reimbursement and ongoing professional development. A diverse, inclusive workplace where innovation — and you — can thrive. How To Apply For immediate consideration, apply online at https://www.home.sandvik/en/careers/ to Req# R0086806 – Global Product Support Specialist – Rotary Drilling . Sandvik is an equal-opportunity employer. We provide reasonable accommodation for applicants with disabilities. For assistance, contact hrsupport.us@sandvik.com .

review_candidates.description: Are you looking at building a career within the Print Industry for a global company with a great culture that will invest in your ongoing training and development? Konica Minolta is innovative, robust and continually evolving. From printing, scanning and copying to cloud storage, industrial print, wide format and robotics, our award-winning products and solutions help companies to transform and move information faster. Our people make this possible. We strive to create and maintain an inclusive workforce as diverse and capable as our class-leading solutions. We actively encourage women and those from diverse backgrounds to apply for our role. Requirements Ideal Candidate We are seeking a technically skilled and customer-focused individual to support our production print customers. The ideal candidate will bring: Experience working with high-volume production printers, digital presses, or similar equipment (Konica Minolta, Ricoh, Fuji, Canon, etc.) Strong problem-solving ability with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset A solid understanding of print workflows, colour quality, and finishing processes Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders The ability to work independently, while maintaining strong team communication and a transparent approach to workload A genuine commitment to continuous learning and technical development Essential Requirements Technical field service experience, ideally with production printers, digital presses, or high-volume print systems Strong mechanical, electrical, and software troubleshooting skills Solid understanding of network connectivity, print servers, and production print environments Proven ability to perform in time-sensitive or high-pressure environments Excellent organisation, time management, and attention to detail Valid Driver's License, with a clean driving record Ability to obtain a Police Check, Working with Children Check, and AGSVA Security Clearance (preferred) Flexibility to participate in an after-hours standby roster, including weekends as required Willingness to travel interstate for product training and development Current Australian working rights (visa sponsorship is not available) Availability for an in-person interview at our Brisbane office About The Role Due to a sharp increase in new high-end Print Production products, we are looking to fill a Field Service Technician position to join our Brisbane Print Production team, providing outstanding service and support to our valuable customer base. The successful candidate will be responsible for the installation and support of Colour and B&W print production equipment and ancillary products with associated software & service solutions. Working within the Brisbane Team, you will ensure customer satisfaction through on-site Corrective and Preventative maintenance on customer equipment. This role works within a team of dedicated technicians and reports directly to the State Service Delivery Manager. As part of your role, you will receive practical benefits including a company-provided vehicle, mobile phone, and other tools necessary to help you succeed on the job and stay connected with your team. Previous experience in the Print Production industry is highly desirable and will be looked upon favourably, although not essential for the right candidate in a similar industry looking to start their career in a hands-on technical role with fantastic learning and development opportunities. As per Konica Minolta compliance procedures, the successful candidate will be required to undertake background checks. Benefits Why Konica Minolta? At Konica Minolta, you'll be part of a collaborative and supportive team culture where you're empowered to contribute your ideas, make a difference and continue developing both personally and professionally. We are committed to creating an inclusive, fair and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion is underpinned by strong ethical practices and corporate responsibility. Our progressive workplace policies, including paid parental leave, flexible working arrangements and domestic and family violence support, are designed to support our people through all stages of their lives. Equal Opportunities We are committed to providing equal opportunities and actively encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply for our roles, regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion or disability. If you require any adjustments/assistance during the recruitment process please reach out to careers@konicaminolta.com.au Join our Team and thrive in an environment built on strong Collaboration , continuous Learning and personal Growth . Everyday at Konica Minolta is an opportunity to share your Ideas , influence Change and engage with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and experiences.

About Us At Datacom, we combine technology, expertise, and talented people to help organisations thrive in a rapidly changing world. As one of Australasia's leading technology providers, we work with customers across industries to solve real-world problems and deliver meaningful outcomes. Whether we're supporting governments, enterprise organisations, or growing businesses, we're committed to creating meaningful outcomes for our customers, communities, and each other. About The Role Working as a Desktop Support Engineer you will be responsible for the provision of all aspects of End User Services to Datacom's customers. Aligned to our customers business requirements, we provide tailored maintenance services, hardware and software break/ fix support, remote support, software deployment and relocation services. Please note that to be eligible for this role, you must be an Australian Citizen. What You'll Do As a Desktop Support Engineer, you will be accountable for, but not limited to: Be the reliable first point of contact — log, triage and resolve tickets to a documented standard, keeping the person updated so they always know where their issue stands Work through desktop and laptop faults methodically — boot and performance issues, driver and patch problems, crashes and freezes, diagnosed against a structured checklist and explained back in plain language Handle identity and access requests carefully — password resets, MFA re-registration, new starter accounts and group changes, each checked against the approval process, then actioned promptly so nobody's left waiting Give new starters a properly prepared device — enrolment, standard build and application packages completed to procedure, so they walk in on day one to equipment that's ready and working Look after mobility devices end to end — phones and tablets enrolled and configured to policy, connectivity and app issues troubleshot, and wipes or re-provisioning handled correctly when a device changes hands Keep hardware, peripherals and print services running — fault-find and swap out devices, manage warranty and repair jobs, and keep the asset register accurate so the team always knows what's where Document what you fix — clear resolution notes and knowledge base articles, so your colleagues can resolve the same fault quickly next time What You'll Bring To be successful in this role, you will have demonstrated the following: Exceptional customer experience with regard to end user services The ability to prioritise work to ensure achievement of all service level agreements Sound knowledge of Laptops, Desktop PC's, printers, media and audio-visual equipment, BYOD and mobility You will bring excellent verbal and written communication and have the ability to articulate technical information to the target audience. Your professional customer service will be second to none, and you will have the ability to work autonomously with excellent time management Culture And Benefits Join a team where you'll be supported to grow your career, prioritise your wellbeing, and make a genuine impact. From industry-leading learning and development opportunities to parental leave, wellbeing support, and employee benefits, we're committed to helping our people thrive both professionally and personally We're passionate about creating a workplace where people feel supported, empowered, and inspired to do their best work. Whether you're developing new skills, tackling complex challenges, or collaborating with some of the best minds in the industry, you'll be part of a team that values curiosity, innovation, inclusion, and making a genuine difference. Why you will love working here Paid parental leave 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (DataCare) Ongoing learning, certifications, and career development opportunities Access to industry-leading learning platforms and future skills training Recognition programmes that celebrate great work Great employee discounts and financial wellbeing benefits Meaningful work that makes a real impact Eligibility criteria and conditions may apply to some benefits.

review_candidates.description: SOVOS Senior Software Engineer (AI Platform Adoption) Product Development·Full-Time·Portugal Build Your Future With Us The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions. We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive. AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. The Role At Sovos, we're transforming how businesses navigate complex regulatory landscapes whilst modernising our technical infrastructure. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to play a hands-on, strategic role helping engineering teams across the organisation adopt our Core Platform and AI Platform capabilities. Positioned at the intersection of engineering, architecture, and AI technology, you'll accelerate delivery, write the playbooks that make adoption easier, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure code ships with quality and confidence. More Specifically, You Will Lead platform adoption by embedding alongside engineering teams, understanding their codebases, identifying adoption blockers, and delivering practical solutions that make Core Platform and AI Platform capabilities feel native to their workflows. Contribute directly to team codebases using AI-assisted development techniques and Core Platform patterns, serving as a trusted guide for teams learning to use AI coding assistants, prompt engineering best practices, and platform APIs. Author and maintain Skills (structured, reusable guidance and automation) that encode best practices for platform adoption, capturing patterns from hands-on engagements and translating them into guidance that helps teams adopt new technologies efficiently. Establish and evolve guidelines for AI coding assistant usage, including prompt engineering, code quality standards, and workflow integration strategies, continuously improving based on real-world feedback. Partner with engineering teams and product stakeholders to co-author test plans for platform-integrated features, supporting end-to-end deployment cycles from development through to production. Identify quality and security considerations for AI-generated and platform-integrated code whilst demonstrating how to incrementally improve architecture and deliver measurable business value. What You Bring to Sovos You can work effectively across multiple codebases and technical domains — whether you've done this across multiple roles or deep in one role, what matters is that you can navigate unfamiliar systems and contribute quickly. You have experience with, or genuine enthusiasm for, AI coding assistants in professional contexts such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar tools. You bring strong technical depth in JavaScript and React, with familiarity in Java and/or .NET service-oriented systems as a plus. You have a track record of enabling other engineers through mentorship, documentation, shared tooling, or hands-on pairing, and can communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You demonstrate strong problem-solving instincts, balancing immediate team needs with longer-term platform and architectural improvements, and can quickly understand unfamiliar codebases, technologies, and technical domains. You possess excellent written communication skills with the ability to author documentation and guidance that other engineers can rely on, and you take a collaborative approach to helping teams adopt new technologies and ways of working. Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. Company Background Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe.
